binds: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd and all its Affiliates (AtliQ Inc is 100% owned by Pvt Ltd, so it is caught by the Affiliate definition in cl. 1.2)
quote: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
plain_english: No analytics, AI or revenue-management work for any hotel, resort or serviced-apartment business that is headquartered in, or has properties in, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain or Oman. Applies wherever the work is done.
ends_note: Term ends 14 Mar 2028 + 18-month Restricted Period (cl. 1.14). Bhavin's belief that it 'expired, it was a 2025 thing' is wrong.
exceptions: Waiver letter 10 Feb 2026 (REG-02) covers only the Seaside Hotels Muscat SOW. Any other engagement needs a new written waiver signed by Al Noor (cl. 12.4).

quote: This consent is strictly limited to the Seaside SOW. It does not extend to (a) any other services provided to Seaside, including any extension, renewal, change order or follow-on statement of work, unless separately consented to in writing by the Client; (b) any other Hospitality Business, whether in the Sultanate of Oman or elsewhere in the GCC; or (c) any Affiliate of the Supplier.
plain_english: Proof the Al Noor restriction is live and has been worked around once, for one Omani hotel only. It does not help any other GCC hotel deal.
ends_note: Tied to the Seaside SOW (C-017, completed 31 Aug 2026).

binds: AtliQ Inc and its Affiliates (so also AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd)
quote: Supplier represents and warrants that the rates, fees and other commercial terms offered to Crestline under this Agreement are and shall remain no less favorable than those offered by Supplier or its Affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services during the Term. If, during the Term, Supplier or any of its Affiliates offers lower rates to any other customer for substantially similar services, Supplier shall promptly notify Crestline, and such lower rates shall apply to Crestline retroactively
plain_english: Any customer of either AtliQ entity who gets a lower rate for similar work triggers a retroactive credit to Crestline, and Crestline can audit once a year. Rate card floor: Sr Data Engineer $85/hr, Data Engineer $62/hr, BI Developer $58/hr.
ends_note: Lasts for the MSA term (expiry 31 Jul 2027 per tracker C-002).
exceptions: Accepted as drafted: 'We never discount, so it's harmless' (negotiation_notes.md).

type: IP assignment of AtliQ background IP (PipeKit)
quote: All Intellectual Property Rights in the Deliverables, including any software, tools, frameworks, libraries and pre-existing materials incorporated into the Deliverables, shall vest in the Client absolutely upon payment of the Charges for the relevant Milestone.
plain_english: The PipeKit components incorporated into the Northwind pipeline were assigned to Northwind outright. AtliQ may no longer be the sole owner of that version of PipeKit, so promising another client that AtliQ 'is the sole owner of PipeKit' could be untrue.
exceptions: K: 'I skimmed the IP and boilerplate' (negotiation_notes.md).

binds: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd and its Affiliates
quote: during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.
plain_english: AtliQ cannot become an implementation, reseller or referral partner of any other cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or unified analytics platform in India or the GCC. Europe and the rest of the world are free (K negotiated Europe out).
ends_note: Term to 31 Aug 2028; either side may terminate for convenience on 90 days' notice.
exceptions: Serving a customer who independently chose another platform is allowed, if AtliQ holds no partner appointment or fee from that platform (cl. 7.3(b)).

counterparty: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd (intercompany) / CareBridge Clinics
binds: AtliQ Inc and AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd
quote: This Agreement applies to the Engagement Services. Any services Subcontractor performs for Business Associate other than the Engagement Services are governed by the Intercompany Agreement.
plain_english: The intercompany BAA that lets the Pune team touch (de-identified) health data covers the CareBridge engagement only. It does not cover Harrington or any other healthcare client. Karandeep chose 'per engagement, keep it simple'.

quote: Personnel of Business Associate or of any Subcontractor located outside the United States may access De-identified Data only, and only within the Covered Entity Environment or a secure environment approved in writing by Covered Entity. No PHI shall be accessed, stored or processed outside the United States.
plain_english: For CareBridge, Pune may only see de-identified data, and de-identified CareBridge data may not be reused for any other client or product.
ends_note: Life of the CareBridge MSA (expiry 5 Oct 2026, renewal pending) plus data return.

quote: The Contractor retains ownership of all intellectual property rights in the Work Product and in any pre-existing materials, components and templates of the Contractor.
plain_english: Rohan owns the Power BI work he built for the Acme dashboards; AtliQ only has a licence. Any client contract that promises the client full ownership of deliverables Rohan worked on promises more than AtliQ owns.
exceptions: Dhaval said fine; K replied 'ok' from his phone.

quote: the Recipient shall not, directly or indirectly, solicit for employment or engagement, or employ or engage, any employee or consultant of Meridian with whom the Recipient had contact in connection with the Purpose, without Meridian's prior written consent.
plain_english: A one-way NDA signed 'within the hour' that also bars AtliQ from hiring or engaging Meridian staff or consultants it met, for the 3-year term plus 24 months, and has an uncapped indemnity.

quote: it shall not develop, license or provide travel-booking software to any online travel agency operating in India.
plain_english: Barred travel-booking software for Indian online travel agencies. Expired 30 Jun 2025 (term end 30 Jun 2024 + 12 months). Kept in the register so nobody re-checks it.

type: Live legacy exposure (uncapped LD, English law)
quote: the Supplier shall pay to the Customer liquidated damages in the amount of one per cent (1%) of the Contract Value for each day or part day by which the relevant Key Date is missed.
plain_english: Still in force until 27 May 2027. Already cost a $9k credit plus $14.2k legal fees. Any further Brightwater work carries the same exposure.

counterparty: Several clients (Al Noor, PayTrack, Acme, Sunrise, CloudSpan)
clause: Al Noor 12.5 (12m), PayTrack 13.1 (12m), Acme 14.1 (6m), Sunrise 15.1 (6m), CloudSpan 16.2 (6m)
quote: Neither Party shall solicit for employment the other Party's employees engaged in the Services during the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter.
plain_english: Routine and mutual. Relevant only when hiring someone from one of these clients.
